summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, furnishing a press release updating the sporting project and 2026/2027 objectives of its Italian soccer club Savoia 1908 FC, now in Serie C. The disclosure covers the club's turnaround since late 2022, a five-year plan achieved in three seasons, youth-focused sustainable model, average squad age of 23.2, and an estimated squad market value of roughly €3.88 million per Transfermarkt. No securities transaction, shareholder vote, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or regulatory clock is involved. Routine operational update; no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
